info.title: MEOGAP Gateway
info.description: Public REST gateway for the MEOGAP platform.

get.description:
Return the service liveness payload.

Args:
----
    None

Returns:
-------
    HealthResponse: status, service name and version.

Return deterministic public product descriptors.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]: public product collection.

Return one deterministic public product descriptor.

Args:
----
    product_id(str): requested product identifier.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: product descriptor.

Return one deterministic product requirement descriptor.

Args:
----
    product_id(str): requested product identifier.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: product requirements.

get.summary: List AOIs owned by the authenticated user.
get.description:
Return all caller-owned saved AOIs.

Args:
----
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]: saved AOIs.

post.summary: Create an AOI owned by the authenticated user.
post.description:
Create one caller-owned AOI.

Args:
----
    payload(AoiCreateRequest): AOI content and geometry.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: created AOI.

get.summary: Retrieve an AOI owned by the authenticated user.
get.description:
Return one caller-owned AOI.

Args:
----
    aoi_id(str): saved AOI identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: saved AOI.

patch.summary: Update an owned AOI and increment its revision.
patch.description:
Update one caller-owned AOI.

Args:
----
    aoi_id(str): saved AOI identifier.
    payload(AoiUpdateRequest): requested AOI changes.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: updated AOI.

delete.summary: Delete an owned AOI. Existing request snapshots are unaffected.
delete.description:
Delete one caller-owned AOI.

Args:
----
    aoi_id(str): saved AOI identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    Response: empty successful deletion response.

get.description:
Return all caller-owned analysis requests.

Args:
----
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]: current request collection.

post.description:
Begin deterministic proposal preparation for an analysis request.

Args:
----
    payload(AnalysisRequestCreateRequest): product, AOI and month range.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: newly created PREPARING request.

get.description:
Return the authoritative lifecycle state for one request.

Args:
----
    request_id(str): request identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: current request state.

post.description:
Atomically debit demo credits and begin deterministic execution.

Args:
----
    request_id(str): request identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: request now in execution.

Cancel a request unless it already completed.

Args:
----
    request_id(str): request identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: cancelled request state.

get.description:
Return an explicit synthetic map representation.

Args:
----
    result_id(str): result identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: synthetic map overlay descriptor.

Return the non-fabricated M0 series placeholder.

Args:
----
    result_id(str): result identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: empty analytical series representation.

Return retained demo request provenance.

Args:
----
    result_id(str): result identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: minimal retained lineage.

post.description:
Start deterministic delivery preparation.

Args:
----
    result_id(str): completed result identifier.
    _(DeliveryCreateRequest): requested delivery kind.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: newly preparing delivery.

get.description:
Return the current delivery state and access URL when ready.

Args:
----
    delivery_id(str): delivery identifier.
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: current delivery state.

Return available deterministic demo credits.

Args:
----
    owner_id(str): deterministic authenticated owner.

Returns:
-------
    dict[str, Any]: balance and demo disclosure.

AnalysisPeriodRequest.title: AnalysisPeriodRequest
AnalysisPeriodRequest.description: Inclusive analysis period expressed in UTC calendar months.

AnalysisRequestCreateRequest.title: AnalysisRequestCreateRequest
AnalysisRequestCreateRequest.description: Payload used to begin deterministic proposal preparation.

AnalysisRequestListResponse.title: AnalysisRequestListResponse
AnalysisRequestListResponse.description: Public collection of caller-owned analysis requests.

AnalysisRequestResponse.title: AnalysisRequestResponse
AnalysisRequestResponse.description: Public analysis request lifecycle state and retained spatial snapshot.

AoiCreateRequest.title: AoiCreateRequest
AoiCreateRequest.description: Payload for one new saved AOI.

AoiGeometry.title: AoiGeometry
AoiGeometry.description: Supported polygonal GeoJSON geometry supplied by the public client.

AoiUpdateRequest.title: AoiUpdateRequest
AoiUpdateRequest.description: Partial payload for an existing saved AOI.

DeliveryCreateRequest.title: DeliveryCreateRequest
DeliveryCreateRequest.description: Delivery representation requested for a completed result.

service.description: Logical service that produced the error.

operation.description: Operation identifier or request path that failed.

ErrorResponse.description: Stable error envelope returned by every failed MEOGAP REST operation.

status.description: Service status; ok when the process answers.

HealthResponse.description: Liveness payload exposed by every MEOGAP service.

ProposalResponse.title: ProposalResponse
ProposalResponse.description: Explicit estimate and limitations available for a proposed request.

ResultLineageResponse.title: ResultLineageResponse
ResultLineageResponse.description: Minimal reliable M0 provenance for one result.

ResultMapResponse.title: ResultMapResponse
ResultMapResponse.description: Map overlay descriptor for a synthetic completed result.

ResultSeriesResponse.title: ResultSeriesResponse
ResultSeriesResponse.description: Series response that avoids fabricating scientific observations.

ProductPreview.title: ProductPreview
ProductPreview.description: Local illustrative preview metadata owned by the product descriptor.

SourceMission.title: SourceMission
SourceMission.description: Source mission labels a product may declare as a requestable input.

ProductCategory.title: ProductCategory
ProductCategory.description: Broad scientific domain used to group products.

ProductAvailability.title: ProductAvailability
ProductAvailability.description: Lifecycle availability of a product definition.

ProductValidationStatus.title: ProductValidationStatus
ProductValidationStatus.description: Scientific validation state explicitly declared by the product owner.
